notes:
1. Settings → AI: AI now starts enabled by default, so "Ask AI" and the AI summaries work as soon as you add a provider and a key. Turn the master switch off if you do not want it.
2. Settings → About: the "Server / Shut down server" card has been removed. Closing the last tab already stops the app, and clicking your odbcapp:// bookmark starts it again.
3. "How to use this app": the first step now spells out the first-time setup — double-click ODBCQueryApp.exe once to register the odbcapp:// link, then save that link as a bookmark and use it from then on.

1. The version number is now shown in small print under the app name in the top-left corner, so you can tell which build you are running without opening Settings.
2. Feedback badge: a post you have read stays read. Read state is remembered per machine by post id, so it also survives updates and restarts instead of re-flagging old posts as unread.
3. Settings → AI: "Use saved API key" now fills in the brand and model that the saved key actually belongs to, rather than only the key itself.
4. AI chat (SQL, script and chart assist): added Volcengine and MiMo as providers, each with its latest flash model.
5. Script page → templates: expanding a template row now shows the columns it requires, the columns it can use optionally, and a list of what the script outputs.
6. Script page → templates: a new Example output column links to a sample dashboard for the template, which opens in a new window so you can see the result before running anything.
7. Script page → templates: the last column is now just the icon — the "Use template" wording has been dropped.
8. New script template "Machine uptime" for the FAB_MESA10 connection, built from the mesa_rsc_downtime / v_fab_mesa_dt_codes / mesa_resource_master query. Plant defaults to B180 and it comes with plant, mes_resource and event_start_date as default criteria; mes_resource shows 180L26C as an example. It produces an uptime dashboard with planned and unplanned downtime percentages, a status timeline, duration histograms and a gravure-change analysis.
9. Test Components: the analysis picker in the left panel is now single-select, so you choose one analysis instead of ticking several.

1. Updates: the app now always reloads onto the new build when an update finishes, whether it was started from the banner at the top or from the Update now button in Settings → About.
2. Discussion pop-up: the Reply button now sits on the same row as the Attach file button, on the right.
3. The connections icon in the top-right corner is always shown, even with no connections, so you can click it to add your first one. The count badge is gone.

1. Results grid: double-click a column header to rename it in place. Enter or clicking away saves the new label, Escape cancels, and clearing the text restores the original name. The rename is a display label only — sorting, filtering, drill-through and copy all keep working on the real column name.
2. Results grid: the rename editor opens on a double-tap on touch screens as well, and double-clicking a header no longer changes the sort order as a side effect.
3. Test Components picker: the list is no longer filtered by result type, so it now offers every component instead of only the "K" results.

1. Uploading a data file now reports progress in three steps — the percentage of the file being sent, the rows read while the file is parsed, and the rows as they land in the grid — instead of one vague "loading" message.
2. Excel workbooks are now read row by row instead of all at once, so the reading stage starts reporting a running row count within seconds and large files use far less memory. CSVs already streamed this way.
3. Script page → AI assist: asking for a chart now produces a real ECharts chart saved as a standalone HTML file you can open in the browser (the chart library is embedded in the page, so it works offline). Charts are also built from the actual query results rather than from the sample row.
4. Fixed a case where the local server could shut down while the app was running from source, which left the page unable to reconnect until the app was restarted.
